scenario.goal_zh: 说明身体不适并理解检查期间的要求。

context_zh: 一次日常摔倒后，伊娃到诊所由护士检查嘴部的不适；对话为虚构沟通练习。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Nurse Lin
sentences.text: Can you tell me what happened?

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: I tripped on a step and hit my mouth. My lower lip is sore.

sentences.speaker: Nurse Lin
sentences.text: May I have a look at the injured area?

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: Yes. Do you need me to open my mouth?

sentences.speaker: Nurse Lin
sentences.text: Just a little, if that is comfortable. Tell me if you need me to stop.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: All right. I can do that.

sentences.speaker: Nurse Lin
sentences.text: Thank you. I have finished looking. Please stay here while I ask the clinician to see you.
